# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server: one player walking a fixed script, the
# client half of the moving-body pose capture.
# Captured 2026-11-16: COD_VERSION=1.5 PORT=<p> PROBE_SECS=85 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_torso
#   mp_carentan, then vcod --net-probe 127.0.0.1:<p> --probe-team allies --save-legs
#   --capture-tag torso-1.5 --probe-secs 70. Only this client half is kept: legs_ab replays it for
#   the anim selection alone (player-model-anim-system.md, the footsteps and weapon order).
# map mp_carentan, gametype probe_torso, team=allies weapon=m1carbine_mp
# placed serverTime=25000 spot=932,-376,-151.875
# client-probes/probe_torso under tools/run_probe.sh puts the player on the spot at
# level time 25000 and logs its bones per frame (the server half, -torso.txt).
# Script from the snapshot that showed the placement, world yaw 0 throughout:
# settle 1500ms f0 r0; fire 1500ms f0 r0 fire; run_fire 1800ms f127 r0 fire; stop 1000ms f0 r0; back_reload 1800ms f-127 r0 reload; stop2 2000ms f0 r0; strafe_fire 1500ms f0 r127 fire; strafe_reload 1500ms f0 r-127 reload; stop3 2000ms f0 r0; crouch 800ms f0 r0 crouch; crouch_fire 1200ms f0 r0 crouch fire; crouch_run_fire 1200ms f127 r0 crouch fire; crouch_back_reload 1500ms f-127 r0 crouch reload; crouch_stop 2000ms f0 r0 crouch; stand 1000ms f0 r0; ads 800ms f0 r0 ads; ads_fire 1500ms f0 r0 fire ads; ads_walk_fire 1500ms f127 r0 fire ads; end 1500ms f0 r0;
# !cmd is a usercmd as it went on the wire (angles rebased on delta_angles; world=
# the angles before), ms after the placement; ms=0 after the first !snap are the
# cmds sent before the probe saw the placement that its commandTime had not run.
# !snap is the playerstate per snapshot: t serverTime, ct commandTime, legs/torso
# the wire anim values. !pcmd and !psnap are the same from the join to the
# placement.
